description: Cameron's iPhone only. Every 15 min: thunderstorms in the next 3 h (severe), gusts 60+ km/h in the next 12 h (severe at 80+), a 33°+ day (before 5 pm, severe at 40+), 3° or colder in the next 18 h (from noon), and rain starting within the hour (Pirate Weather minutely). Plus new BoM warnings (major = severe). Non-severe alerts are held back 10 pm to 7 am; severe ones come any time as time-sensitive. Each kind repeats at most every 3 h (rain), 6 h (thunder) or 12 h (the rest); input_text.weather_alerts_sent remembers when each last went. Tapping opens the Weather dashboard.

conditions.value_template: {{ trigger.from_state is not none and trigger.from_state.state not in ['unknown', 'unavailable'] and trigger.to_state.state not in ['unknown', 'unavailable'] }}

variables.new: {% set old = (trigger.from_state.attributes.warnings or []) | map(attribute='id') | list %}{% set ns = namespace(out=[]) %}{% for w in trigger.to_state.attributes.warnings or [] %}{% if w.id not in old and w.type != 'sheep_graziers_warning' and (w.warning_group_type == 'major' or not quiet) %}{% set ns.out = ns.out + [w] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.out }}

data.title: {{ new[0].short_title }}{{ ' and %d more' % (new | count - 1) if new | count > 1 else '' }}

push.interruption-level: {{ 'time-sensitive' if new | selectattr('warning_group_type', 'eq', 'major') | list | count else 'active' }}

variables.sent: {% set s = states('input_text.weather_alerts_sent') %}{{ s | from_json if s.startswith('{') else {} }}

variables.due: {% set ns = namespace(out=[]) %}{% for a in alerts %}{% if (a.severe or not quiet) and now().timestamp() - (sent.get(a.key, 0) | float(0)) > gap[a.key] %}{% set ns.out = ns.out + [a] %}{% endif %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.out }}

data.value: {% set ns = namespace(d=dict(sent)) %}{% for a in due %}{% set ns.d = dict(ns.d, **{a.key: now().timestamp() | int}) %}{% endfor %}{{ ns.d | to_json }}
